documents.title: Listing Approval From BSE Limited & National Stock Exchange Of India Limited For 15,01,434 Equity Shares Of Rs 2/- Each Under Preferential Basis.
Fixation Of Book Closure Dates For The 41St AGM

analysis.summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited reported quarterly turnover of over Rs 700 crores with sales volumes of 5,200 tons in Q1 FY27. Operations normalized in June with 2,200 tons dispatched following trade route disruptions during April and May. Management projects full-year volume growth between 12% and 15% alongside EBITDA margins maintained between 5% and 5.5%. The company is executing a Rs 40 crore capex program over FY27-FY28 and progressing with corporate restructuring to demerge its copper business into Tieramet Limited. Bhagyanagar India Limited presented its Q1FY27 investor presentation, reporting consolidated operational revenue of Rs 70,507.54 lakhs and an EBITDA margin of 5.43%.

guidance.claim: Management expects full-year sales volume growth to be between 12% and 15%.
guidance.quote: So, | think we should be looking at between 12% to 15% growth in terms of volume for the whole year now.

guidance.claim: The company expects average realization value to be roughly 30% higher this year compared to last year.
guidance.quote: With regard to the value, | think compared to last year, we should get about 30% higher.

guidance.claim: Management targets ending the current year with a value-added product mix between 63% and 64%.
guidance.quote: In terms of our value-added percentage, we are looking at between 63% and 64% for this year.

guidance.claim: The company targets exports to account for 12% to 15% of total sales this year.
guidance.quote: 12-15% would be a good estimate for the year.

guidance.claim: Management expresses confidence in reaching Rs 5,000 crores in revenue by FY30.
guidance.quote: But we are very confident of 5,000 crores by FY30, whatever the copper price.

guidance.claim: Management is aiming to achieve maintaining a 5% EBITDA margin through the next year.
guidance.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

guidance.claim: The company targets a 25% CAGR over the next 3 to 4 years.
guidance.quote: 25% CAGR is our target for the next 3 to 4 years.

guidance.claim: Management expects 20% volume growth and a 5% price increase.
guidance.quote: Out of the 25%, we are expecting 20% volume growth and 5% increase in prices.

demand_outlook.claim: Secondary copper demand in India is projected to double from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons over the next 5 years.
demand_outlook.quote: Out of this, if you look at the secondary copper demand, it is expected to double in the next 5 years, from 0.7 million metric tons to 1.4 million metric tons.

demand_outlook.claim: The recycled copper market in India is estimated to grow at a CAGR of approximately 12% to 13%.
demand_outlook.quote: The recycled copper market, by some estimates, should be growing in India at a CAGR of about 12-13%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted strong demand outlook as existing customers discuss plans to double capacity within the next 3 years.
demand_outlook.quote: All our customers are looking to increase their volumes and everybody is talking about doubling their capacity in the next 3 years.

demand_outlook.claim: Growing sustainability focus and supply constraints are driving the shift from primary to recycled copper in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Growing sustainability focus and supply constraints are accelerating the transition from primary to recycled copper in India.

demand_outlook.claim: Market demand and increased capacities enabled a shift towards value-added products.
demand_outlook.quote: In Q1, we had only 52% of value-added products, and due to demand from the market, and due to increase in capacities of value-added products.

demand_outlook.claim: India is projected to become the world's second largest copper-consuming economy.
demand_outlook.quote: India is expected to become the second largest copper-consuming economy.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has proposed Rs 40 crores of capital expenditure across FY27 and FY28.
capex_expansion.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

capex_expansion.claim: The company completed adding 35,000 metric tons of capacity, which is currently online.
capex_expansion.quote: We have also finished adding our capacity of 35,000 metric tons, which is online now.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity expansion from 35,000 to 45,000 tons is planned to become operational between April and June of next year.
capex_expansion.quote: The exact timelines are still not there, but as of now, our expectation is between April and June of next year; more likely June next year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding its CTC wires capacity from about 80 metric tons per month to 150 metric tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: On CTC wires, our capacity is roughly about 80 metric tons a month and we will be going up to 150 metric tons a month.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to invest around Rs 10 crore in plastic recycling.
capex_expansion.quote: So, right now, we are planning to invest around 10 crores into plastic recycling, where the cable waste comes in, we process them into different grades, we make granules, and with aluminium and other metals, we make ingots, and then we put them back into the supply chain.

capex_expansion.claim: Management proposes a Rs 40 crore capex plan over the next 2 years.
capex_expansion.quote: We are proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.

capex_expansion.claim: The company aims to expand its value-added product mix to 66% by the end of next year.
capex_expansion.quote: So, we've already reached around 62% at the end of quarter four, and we are planning to get this up to 66% by the end of next year.

margins_costs.claim: The company recorded an EBITDA margin of 5.43% and a PAT margin of 2.87% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: We have achieved an EBITDA margin of 5.43%, which is a 10.38% growth over the last quarter and a 63% growth over the first quarter of last year.

margins_costs.claim: The company recorded its highest EBITDA per kg of Rs 72 in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: We have also had our highest share of value-added products sold this quarter, which is 63% and our highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects to maintain EBITDA margins between 5% and 5.5% for the full year.
margins_costs.quote: Going forward in the year, we hope to maintain the EBITDA margin between 5% and 5.5%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per kg reached INR 72.55 in Q1FY27 compared to INR 28.68 in Q1FY26.
EBITDA per kg reached around Rs 62 per kg in Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: Our EBITDA per kg for the year is around 43 rupees, which is very high compared to our peers, and as you can see, over the four quarters, our EBITDA per kg has been trending upwards. With the quarter four, we achieved around 62 rupees per kg.

margins_costs.claim: Copper value-added products provide the highest margin opportunities.
margins_costs.quote: No, the higher margin business will be various, copper value-added products.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volume reached 5,200 tons for Q1 FY27, with 2,200 tons delivered in June.
orders_capacity.quote: However, for the whole quarter, our volume has come down to 5,200 tons. But the good part of this is that 2,200 tons of the 5,200 tons has come only in the month of June.

orders_capacity.claim: Value-added products represented 63% of total sales volume in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: We have also had our highest share of value-added products sold this quarter, which is 63% and our highest EBITDA per kg of 72 rupees.

orders_capacity.claim: Exports accounted for 18% of segment-wise sales in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: As you can see, in quarter one of FY27, 18% of our sales have come from exports.

orders_capacity.claim: Annual capacity reached 35,000 metric tonnes with a new facility near Hyderabad.
orders_capacity.quote: Our capacity has now reached 35,000 metric tonne this year, with the new, 60-acre integrated facility near Hyderabad.

orders_capacity.claim: Copper sales volume grew 34% to 24,000 metric tonnes in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Last year, we did around 18,000 metric tonne of volume of copper sales. Which has gone up by 34% to, 2 24,000 metric tonne.

capital_allocation.claim: The company finalized its first round of fundraising for Rs 52 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we have just finalized the first round of raising, at 52 crores, which is finalized, and the money should be in the bank in the month of August.

capital_allocation.claim: A second tranche of fundraising is planned around March after the business demerger is completed.
capital_allocation.quote: The second tranche will probably be around March, after the demerger is done, in the standalone copper unit.

capital_allocation.claim: Management projects debt levels to be between Rs 300 crores and Rs 350 crores in 2030.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our projection is showing that between 300 and 350 crores will be our debt in 2030.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is restructuring to transfer its copper business to new wholly owned subsidiary Tieramet Limited prior to demerging it.
capital_allocation.quote: We are going to form a new company called Tieramet Limited, which will be a wholly owned subsidiary of Bhagyanagar India.

capital_allocation.claim: The company initiated a preferential issue of equity shares to non-promoters to raise Rs 52.25 crores.
Working capital expanded from Rs 157 crore to Rs 230 crore alongside revenue growth.
capital_allocation.quote: So, our working capital has gone up from 157 crores to 230 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is undergoing corporate demerger into separate real estate and copper businesses.
capital_allocation.quote: As has been earlier announced, the company is in a structure of demerging into two sectors.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is considering a fundraising plan of approximately Rs 150 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: So, we are looking at a fundraise. We are still not, come up with a final proposal, but we are looking at a fundraise of roughly about 150 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Trade route disruptions and material shortages during April and May led to a temporary drop in quarterly sales volumes.
risks_headwinds.quote: In the first two months, because of the disruption of all the trade routes and the shortage of material all over the country, while the turnover came down, we could take advantage of the situation by increasing our margins.

risks_headwinds.claim: A GST case was initiated against the company due to retrospective cancellation of a scrap supplier's registration.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because of the retrospective cancellation of the registration of the supplier, the case has been put on us.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company deposited Rs 17 crores regarding the GST retrospective registration dispute.
Scrap availability from the Gulf region temporarily dried up due to transit and shipping disruptions.
risks_headwinds.quote: The scrap coming from Gulf, which is of a short duration, short lead time material, has suddenly dried up.

risks_headwinds.claim: First quarter volume may experience a slight drop compared to Q4 due to raw material shipping delays.
risks_headwinds.quote: Having said that, I do see that in the first quarter, my volume might be slightly lower than the fourth quarter.

management_commitments.claim: Management has proposed Rs 40 crores of capital expenditure across FY27 and FY28.
management_commitments.quote: The management has proposed to do 40 crores of capex in the next 2 years, FY27 and FY28 and we are well on our way to achieve this.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to execute a complete digital transformation across all departments over the next year.
management_commitments.quote: Over the next year, we are going to do a complete digital transformation of our company, where every process, every department and all reporting will be completely digitalized automatically, and no manual entry would be required.

management_commitments.claim: The company finalized a fundraise of Rs 52 crores with funds expected in August.
management_commitments.quote: So, we have just finalized the first round of raising, at 52 crores, which is finalized, and the money should be in the bank in the month of August.

management_commitments.claim: The company proposes to spend Rs 40 crore on capex over the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: We are proposing about 40 crores capex in the next 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to raise the share of value-added products to 66% by the end of next year.
management_commitments.quote: So, we've already reached around 62% at the end of quarter four, and we are planning to get this up to 66% by the end of next year.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to maintain an EBITDA margin of 5% throughout the next year.
management_commitments.quote: We are hopeful of maintaining 5% EBITDA margin throughout the next year, and on an increased top line.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to execute a fundraise of roughly Rs 150 crore in the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We hope to do it in this financial year, definitely.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
